text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When Mejiro Dober sees how popular Air Groove is with the crowd, she realizes she's far from the legacy she dreams of forging, but she manages to keep her spirits up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober can't quite conceal her admiration for Air Groove as she vows to get closer to her ideal.
